evidence.quote: Today I hope to give you some insights into how I am approaching the work of evaluating and improving the post-crisis regulatory regime
I believe it is time to take concrete steps toward calibrating liquidity requirements differently for large, non-G-SIBs than for G-SIBs.
While I do not know precisely the socially optimal number of loss absorbency requirements for large banking firms, I am reasonably certain that 24 is too many.

parsed.rationale: The speech addresses bank regulation and supervision (tailoring, capital simplification, stress testing transparency) and says nothing about monetary policy, inflation, or the economic outlook. It therefore carries no monetary policy stance signal.
